Do you want a job where you truly make a difference in people’s everyday lives?
Hemfrid is Sweden’s largest home cleaning company. We help our customers with cleaning, window cleaning, and other home services – always with quality and care.
We are now looking for you who want to work as a cleaner in Partille and surrounding areas. With us, you will become part of an international team with colleagues from all over the world. Together, we deliver world-class service!
What do we offer?
· A 75 - 85% position
· Collective agreement and secure employment terms
· Fixed monthly salary – the same salary every month
· Mileage compensation between customers if you use your own car for work
· Paid travel time between customers
· Insurance (health, liability, and occupational pension)
· We care about your health! That’s why we offer a wellness allowance of SEK 2,400 per year
· Free mobile phone subscription
· Free training in home cleaning and further education in service and cleaning
· Field Lead/Buddy – point of contact and support for team members in the field on cleaning operations.
· Team meetings and social events
With us, you get the right conditions to succeed. If you have the motivation, we will give you the tools to excel!
Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone who:
· Enjoys working both independently and in a team
· Is detail-oriented, responsible, and committed
· Wants to grow and develop
· Speaks Swedish or English
· Can work flexible hours (Monday–Friday between 08:00–17:00)
· Is flexible and enjoys working with different customers
Meritorious:
· B driver’s license and access to your own car
· Experience in cleaning or service-related jobs
Apply today! Read more at www.hemfrid.se/karriar and apply  If you have questions, feel free to contact us at hr@hemfrid.se
We look forward to hearing from you! ✨

The Opportunity
Hitachi Energy Cooling Systems is currently experiencing strong growth and is looking to strengthen our Plant Design team with a Project Engineer. Our mechanical design work is divided into three areas: system design, design of units that are assembled and tested in our factory, and design of external piping systems, where pipes are welded and delivered to site for installation.
This position is part of one of our mechanical design teams, responsible for designing external piping systems in a project-based environment.
The team is based in Landskrona, Sweden. We are a strong and collaborative team with a broad range of shared expertise, where teamwork is always a top priority.
We are excited to get to know you and learn what you can bring to the team, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
How you’ll make an impact
Perform mechanical design work for external piping systems within project deliveries.
Create 3D models of piping systems and pipe supports based on process flow diagrams, specifications, and component lists.
Review and verify engineering drawings to ensure quality and compliance.
Manage material registration and bill of materials (BOM) creation in our ERP system.
Collaborate closely with customers, colleagues, and cross-functional teams such as Procurement and Production.
Work with engineering and business systems including Solid Edge and SAP. 

Your background
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.
A few years of experience in piping design and mechanical design engineering or closely related engineering disciplines. Combined with a desire to continue learning and growing.
Experience working in project-based environments.
Proficiency in 3D modeling and design tools.
Experience from industries such as industrial cooling, water and wastewater treatment, biogas, marine, oil and gas, or nuclear power is an asset.
A proactive and self-driven approach, with the ability to manage priorities and meet project deadlines.
Curiosity, problem-solving skills, and a practical understanding of manufacturing and installation processes.
Fluent in both Swedish and English.

More about us 
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​
Health care and wellness allowance​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​
Psychological support program​​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​
Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.
Recruiting Manager Anders Ekman, anders.ekman@hitachienergy.com, will answer your questions about the position.
All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Elina Mannelqvist, elina.mannelqvist@hitachienergy.com

About Edblad
Edblad is a Swedish jewelry brand with a strong Scandinavian identity and a passion for creating accessible, contemporary jewelry designed to be worn every day. With a growing international presence, Edblad continues to develop its digital business and customer experience across multiple European markets.
In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how Edblad tells its story digitally and contribute to the continued development of our e-commerce business.
About the role
As Senior e-commerce Content Creator, you will take ownership of how the Edblad story is brought to life across e-commerce, with the website as your primary channel.
This is a key role at the intersection of e-commerce and Marketing. You will take seasonal campaigns, concepts and creative direction from Marketing and Design and turn them into relevant and engaging digital content - from editorial stories and landing pages to gift guides, category content and other inspirational touchpoints.
Working across our international markets, you will consider the audience, market maturity and stage of the customer journey when shaping the message. Creativity and strong copywriting are at the heart of the role, combined with a commercial and data-driven approach to continuously improve how our content performs.
Key responsibilities:
Own the storytelling and consistency of e-commerce content, with the website as the primary channel
Translate seasonal campaigns and creative concepts into inspiring and commercially relevant digital content
Create and develop copy, editorial content, landing pages, gift guides and other inspirational content around the Edblad brand, collections and products
Adapt content and messaging to different markets, audiences, channels and stages of the customer journey
Use GA4 and content performance data to evaluate, optimize and develop content based on customer behaviour and commercial objectives
Develop content with SEO, search intent and evolving AI-driven search behaviours in mind
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Design, Performance, Social Media and E-commerce, including briefing additional content and assets when needed

Who we are looking for
We are looking for a senior content professional with excellent copywriting and storytelling skills and a strong understanding of e-commerce.
You have a strong creative instinct and know how to communicate a brand in a way that feels relevant and engaging. At the same time, you are comfortable using data to challenge assumptions, understand what resonates with customers, and make informed decisions about what to develop further.
As a person, you are proactive, curious, and eager to learn. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across functions and keeping up with new technologies, content trends and changing customer behaviours.
Experience & skills:
3+ years of relevant experience within e-commerce content, digital content, editorial content or a similar role
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice
Strong understanding of e-commerce and how content can support commercial objectives
Experience using GA4 or similar tools to evaluate content performance and inform decisions
Good understanding of SEO and search intent
Experience working with content across different markets and audiences
Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
Experience from fashion, jewelry, beauty, lifestyle, retail or D2C, as well as experience with Storyblok, Centra or international e-commerce, is considered an advantage

An interest in AI, GEO, and how new search behaviours are changing the way customers discover brands and products is a plus.
Location & start
The position is based at Edblad’s office in Stockholm. Edblad offers a hybrid working model with the possibility to work remotely.
Contact & application
If you have any questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact the responsible recruiter, Julia Salming, at julia@ecommercerecruit.se (jennifer@ecommercerecruit.se).
As we review applications on an ongoing basis, we recommend submitting your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Platform & Technical Lead  Handheld R&D Product Design  Husqvarna Group
jobs.description:
At Handheld R&D Product Design, we shape the next generation of leaf blowers, trimmers, brushcutters, hedge trimmers, and pole products used by professionals and consumers worldwide.
From new technologies and product development to continuous improvements of our existing portfolio, we work across the entire product lifecycle. Here, you will join a collaborative and hands-on R&D environment with access to modern prototyping facilities and laboratories, working closely with colleagues across R&D, manufacturing, verification, and other key functions.
Role Description
As Platform & Technical Lead, you will play a key role in developing robust, competitive products with a strong focus on quality, performance, and cost efficiency.
You will lead and coordinate technical activities and cross-functional projects, ranging from new technologies and products to improvements of existing platforms. With a broad perspective on both technology and business, you will help turn requirements and ideas into effective solutions. Your responsibilities include:
Lead and coordinate cross-functional development and improvement projects.
Drive technical and architectural decisions based on product, market, quality, and cost requirements.
Manage requirements, technical risks, and key technical decisions throughout development.
Follow up project progress and results from both technical and financial perspectives.
Develop platform strategies and initiate and prioritize activities to achieve agreed targets.
Collaborate closely with specialists within materials, verification, prototyping, CAE, operations, and external partners.

Your profile
You are structured and able to prioritize and drive your work towards defined objectives. With a collaborative and pragmatic mindset, you enjoy solving problems together with others and sharing knowledge. You are curious, take initiative, and are motivated by continuous learning and development.
You may already be an experienced Technical Project Manager or be ready to take the next step into a broader technical leadership role. What matters most is that you bring a strong technical foundation, the ability to create structure, and the motivation to drive development together with others. We believe you have:
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field.
Solid experience in mechanical design and product development.
Experience in, or a strong interest in developing further within, technical project leadership.
Fluency in both English and Swedish.

Location
Our team is based in Huskvarna, where we strongly believe in the value of working closely together. Some flexibility is possible, but we aim for on‑site presence since collaboration is at the core of how we work.
Application
Please apply with CV and Cover letter. We do not accept applications by email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Jakob Engström, jakob.engstrom@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.
Processing of personal data
When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.
Winning Through Culture 
We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.   
Our culture is built on three core themes: 
Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. 

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! 
Learn more about our culture here.

Senior Software Developer - Network Control R&D -  Job Summary
The R&D Network Control team is looking to onboard an expert Senior Software Developer at our development team located in Sweden. In this role you work in close collaboration with other developers, product owners, architects and testers. You will be developing the power grids of the future, creating software that is used in crucial infrastructure and real time. The product is designed to have a long life while also being very efficient and secure. 
How you’ll make an impact
The Senior Software Developer handles designing, developing, and maintaining mission-critical software solutions that support electric utility transmission, distribution, generation, and market operations. 
This role contributes to the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance applications within Hitachi Energy's Network Control portfolio, including SCADA, EMS, DMS, ADMS, WAMS, and related platforms. 
As a senior technical contributor, the individual drives development and maintenance activities, ensures high-quality software delivery, and collaborates closely with Product Management, System Architects, Quality Assurance, and Customer Delivery teams. The role combines strong technical ability with customer-focused mindset to deliver reliable solutions for critical infrastructure.
Your Background 
University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum 5 years of professional software development experience in enterprise, high-performance, or mission-critical software environments.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments with cross-functional global teams.
Experience working in fast passed environment, quickly adapts to changing priorities and business needs.
Proven experience in identifying root causes of complex software issues and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Comfortable working in customer-facing environments and taking part in technical discussions with customers and stakeholders.

Technical Competencies
Expert proficiency in C# and .NET Framework/.NET platform development
Experience with C++ development is an added advantage.
Expertise in scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript
Strong hands-on experience developing Windows desktop applications using WPF, Experience building rich client applications.
Strong hands-on experience with WCF, REST APIs, Web Services, Inter-Process Communication and Message-based communication framework
Strong knowledge of Multithreading, Asynchronous Programming, Process and Thread Synchronization, Performance Tuning and Optimization
Experience working with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and architecture patterns (Microservices, SOA, Distributed System Architecture)
Experience developing Application Domains (AppDomain), Cross-process communication, Native and managed code interaction, System-level and kernel-level API interaction.
Experience with SQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL/Data Modeling/ Query Optimization / Database Performance Tunning
Experience with File Handling, Serialization / Deserialization techniques
Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
